title: Margin Focus List

storyline.headline: Store leaders need a cleaner margin view
storyline.summary: A retail operations report has too many fields. Prepare only the columns needed for a margin conversation.

objectives: Select the product and margin fields from the store report.
starterCode:
import pandas as pd
report = pd.read_csv('store_report.csv')
hints: Square brackets select named columns from a DataFrame.
Use a list inside the brackets when you need more than one field.
businessInsight: Focused reports reduce noise and help decision-makers see the relevant commercial drivers.

handbook.heading: Select one column
handbook.whatItDoes: Square brackets retrieve a named column.
handbook.useCase: Use it to focus one measure.

handbook.heading: Select several columns
handbook.whatItDoes: A list of names creates a smaller table.
handbook.useCase: Use it to build a decision-ready view.
